legend: Bill is a famous mathematician in BubbleLand. Thanks to his revolutionary math discoveries he was able to make enough money to build a beautiful house. Unfortunately, for not paying property tax on time, court decided to punish Bill by making him lose a part of his property.
Bill’s property can be observed as a convex regular 2n-sided polygon A0 A1... A2n - 1 A2n,  A2n =  A0, with sides of the exactly 1 meter in length.
Court rules for removing part of his property are as follows:
Split every edge Ak Ak + 1,  k = 0... 2n - 1 in n equal parts of size 1 / n with points P0, P1, ..., Pn - 1

On every edge A2k A2k + 1,  k = 0... n - 1 court will choose one point B2k =  Pi for some i = 0, ...,  n - 1 such that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/82be7fdb09b6214407fa34174365142e65a61665.png)

On every edge A2k + 1A2k + 2,  k = 0...n - 1 Bill will choose one point B2k + 1 =  Pi for some i = 0, ...,  n - 1 such that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3212ccd11483d157eac0daeb0ef542d5197e2cee.png)
Bill gets to keep property inside of 2n-sided polygon B0 B1... B2n - 1

Luckily, Bill found out which B2k points the court chose. Even though he is a great mathematician, his house is very big and he has a hard time calculating. Therefore, he is asking you to help him choose points so he maximizes area of property he can keep.
input: The first line contains one integer number n (2 ≤ n ≤ 50000), representing number of edges of 2n-sided polygon.

The second line contains n distinct integer numbers B2k (0 ≤ B2k ≤ n - 1,  k = 0... n - 1) separated by a single space, representing points the court chose. If B2k = i, the court chose point Pi on side A2k A2k + 1.
output: Output contains n distinct integers separated by a single space representing points B1, B3, ..., B2n - 1 Bill should choose in order to maximize the property area. If there are multiple solutions that maximize the area, return any of them.
note: To maximize area Bill should choose points: B1 = P0, B3 = P2, B5 = P1

legend.ai: Bill 是 BubbleLand 的一位著名数学家。得益于他革命性的数学发现，他赚到了足够的钱，建造了一座美丽的房子。遗憾的是，由于没有按时缴纳财产税，法院决定惩罚 Bill，让他失去部分财产。
Bill 的财产可以看作一个凸正 2n 边形 A0 A1... A2n - 1 A2n，  A2n =  A0，其每条边的长度恰好为 1 米。
法院规定，移除他部分财产的规则如下：
将每条边 Ak Ak + 1（k = 0... 2n - 1）等分为 n 份，每份长度为 1 / n，并标记点 P0，P1，...，Pn - 1
在每条边 A2k A2k + 1 上， k = 0... n - 1，法庭将选择一个点 B2k = Pi，其中 i = 0，...，n - 1，使得 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/82be7fdb09b6214407fa34174365142e65a61665.png)
在每条边 A2k + 1A2k + 2 上， k = 0...n - 1，比尔将选择一个点 B2k + 1 = Pi，其中 i = 0，...，n - 1，使得 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3212ccd11483d157eac0daeb0ef542d5197e2cee.png)
比尔可以保留 2n 边形 B0 B1... B2n - 1 内部的财产。
幸运的是，比尔得知了法庭选择的 B2k 点。尽管他是一位伟大的数学家，但他的房子非常大，计算起来很困难。因此，他请求你帮助他选择点，使他能够保留的财产面积最大。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 50000），表示 2n 边形的边数。
第二行包含 n 个互不相同的整数 B2k（0 ≤ B2k ≤ n - 1， k = 0... n - 1），整数之间以单个空格分隔，表示法庭选择的点。如果 B2k = i，则法庭在边 A2k A2k + 1 上选择了点 Pi。

output.ai: 输出 n 个互不相同的整数，整数之间用一个空格分隔，表示 Bill 应按顺序选择的点 B1、B3、...、B2n - 1，以使图形面积最大。如果有多个方案都能使面积最大，输出其中任意一个即可。

note.ai: 为了使面积最大，Bill 应选择以下点：B1 = P0，B3 = P2，B5 = P1
